data.exact_reserve_text: The Syndicate has experienced a positive run off deviation of GBP 3,031k in the year, predominantly in respect of Property and Accident & Health business (2015: GBP 3,679k, predominantly in respect of Accident & Health business).
data.standardized_narrative: At 1 January 2016 the syndicate carried gross claims outstanding of GBP 48.51m. During 2016 there was a net release on prior year claims of GBP 12.891m (a c.26.6% reduction of opening gross claims), described in the report as a positive run-off deviation predominantly in respect of Property and Accident & Health business. The movement is reported as favourable claims development (positive run-off) rather than a deterioration.
raw_causal_phrases: The Syndicate has experienced a positive run off deviation of GBP 3,031k in the year, predominantly in respect of Property and Accident & Health business (2015: GBP 3,679k, predominantly in respect of Accident & Health business).

The claims experience in 2016 reflects an increase in the level of catastrophe losses over the previous year, and a small number of large risk losses in addition to the expected level of claims activity on the account.
data.data_quality_notes: Opening gross claims outstanding and the 'Change in prior year provisions' gross figure were taken from the Technical Provisions table (page 36). Prior year development used the 'Change in prior year provisions' gross amount. The report also contains a net claims development triangle (page 35) which was reviewed; the triangle is presented on a net basis. No specific named catastrophe events affecting prior years were identified in the technical reserves narrative beyond generic references to catastrophe and large losses.
